mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 1% month-over-month, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicates strong labor market and consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days; the effect requires both conditions to be met.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST*UNRATE interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window, or positive returns occur in less than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rise >= 0.25% in 3mo AND INDPRO decline for 2mo) reduce liquidity and signal economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rise >= 0.25% in 3mo AND INDPRO decline for 2mo
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 95 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction and supply chain disruption, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 7.5% indicates weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Combined rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and interest rates (FEDFUNDS) indicates aggressive monetary policy response to inflation, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days; the effect requires both conditions to be met.
failure_condition: Rank IC for CPIAUCSL*FEDFUNDS interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window, or negative returns occur in less than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 425,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 425000, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.
